correctness.rationale: Finite Sierpinski geometry and Hamiltonian domains are explicit. Exact elimination of each new midpoint triangle gives K_(m+1)(z)=((z+2)K_m(z(z-3))+2z I)/((z+1)(z-2)). The two symmetry scalar rational functions have reduced numerator degrees 2^(m-1)+1 and 2^m for m>=1; both cancellations at -1 and 2 are classified, and no other common factors occur. Spectral measure residue ranks give dim K=degree_s+2 degree_t without assuming cross-sector eigenvalue disjointness. Positive local absorber rates damp exactly its orthogonal complement. Independent direct two-prime rank tests cover m=0..5; exact rational resolvent inversion checks m=0..2. Finite tests are not used as the infinite proof.
